defmodule FirmwareHub.TenantRouter do
  @moduledoc """
  Multi-tenant firmware distribution for IoT devices.
  Each tenant has isolated firmware namespaces identified by tenant_id.
  Device identifiers use Unicode to support international deployments.
  """

  use Plug.Router
  require Logger

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  @firmware_base "/var/firmware"

  # Tenant isolation boundary - maps normalized tenant to their allowed device families
  @tenant_registry %{
    "acme_corp" => ["sensor_alpha", "gateway_v2"],
    "büro_gmbh" => ["klimasensor", "türsteuerung"],
    "café_iot" => ["thermostat", "barista_module"]
  }

  get "/api/v1/firmware/:tenant_id/:device_family/latest" do
    with {:ok, tenant} <- validate_tenant(tenant_id),
         {:ok, family} <- validate_device_family(tenant, device_family),
         {:ok, path} <- resolve_firmware_path(tenant, family) do
      send_file(conn, 200, path)
    else
      {:error, :invalid_tenant} ->
        send_resp(conn, 403, "Access denied: unknown tenant")
      {:error, :invalid_family} ->
        send_resp(conn, 404, "Device family not found for tenant")
      {:error, :not_found} ->
        send_resp(conn, 404, "Firmware binary not available")
    end
  end

  get "/api/v1/firmware/:tenant_id/:device_family/manifest" do
    with {:ok, tenant} <- validate_tenant(tenant_id),
         {:ok, family} <- validate_device_family(tenant, device_family) do
      manifest = build_manifest(tenant, family)
      json_resp(conn, 200, manifest)
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        send_resp(conn, 403, "Denied: #{reason}")
    end
  end

  # Core tenant validation: normalize the tenant identifier for lookup
  defp validate_tenant(raw_tenant_id) do
    # NFC normalization for consistent tenant matching
    normalized = :unicode.characters_to_nfc_binary(raw_tenant_id)
    if Map.has_key?(@tenant_registry, normalized) do
      {:ok, normalized}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_tenant}
    end
  end

  # Validate device family belongs to the authenticated tenant
  defp validate_device_family(tenant, raw_family) do
    # NFD normalization for device family identifiers
    normalized_family = :unicode.characters_to_nfd_binary(raw_family)
    allowed = Map.get(@tenant_registry, tenant, [])
    if normalized_family in allowed do
      {:ok, normalized_family}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_family}
    end
  end

  # Resolve the actual firmware binary path with tenant isolation
  defp resolve_firmware_path(tenant, device_family) do
    # Build path using the validated tenant and family
    base = Path.join([@firmware_base, tenant, device_family])
    firmware_file = Path.join(base, "firmware.bin")

    # Security: ensure resolved path stays within tenant boundary
    tenant_root = Path.join(@firmware_base, tenant)
    resolved = Path.expand(firmware_file)

    if String.starts_with?(resolved, tenant_root) do
      if File.exists?(resolved) do
        {:ok, resolved}
      else
        {:error, :not_found}
      end
    else
      Logger.warn("Path traversal attempt: #{resolved}")
      {:error, :invalid_family}
    end
  end

  defp build_manifest(tenant, family) do
    %{
      tenant: tenant,
      device_family: family,
      version: get_latest_version(tenant, family),
      checksum: compute_checksum(tenant, family),
      updated_at: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601()
    }
  end

  defp get_latest_version(tenant, family) do
    version_file = Path.join([@firmware_base, tenant, family, "VERSION"])
    case File.read(version_file) do
      {:ok, content} -> String.trim(content)
      _ -> "unknown"
    end
  end

  defp compute_checksum(tenant, family) do
    firmware_path = Path.join([@firmware_base, tenant, family, "firmware.bin"])
    case File.read(firmware_path) do
      {:ok, data} -> :crypto.hash(:sha256, data) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
      _ -> nil
    end
  end

  defp json_resp(conn, status, data) do
    conn
    |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
    |> send_resp(status, Jason.encode!(data))
  end
end
